properties.query:
let ASimNetworkSessionUbiquitiUniFiNetwork = (disabled: bool = false, pack: bool = false) {
    // ASIM NetworkSession parser for Ubiquiti UniFi Network (UDM Pro) CEF syslog
    // Source table: Ubiquiti_CL (raw CEF syslog line stored in Message)
    // Covers UniFi Network event classes: 201 (Threat Detected and Blocked), 203 (Blocked by Firewall),
    // 400/401/402 (WiFi Client Connected/Disconnected/Roamed), 403/404 (Wired Client Connected/Disconnected),
    // 520/521 (VPN Client Connected/Disconnected), 522/523 (Teleport Client Connected/Disconnected)
    let SanitizeHostname = (h: string) {
        trim(@'-+$', trim(@'^-+', replace_regex(h, @'[^A-Za-z0-9\-]+', '-')))
    };
    let SeverityToASim = (sev: int) {
        case(
            sev <= 3, "Informational",
            sev <= 6, "Low",
            sev <= 8, "Medium",
            "High"
        )
    };
    let RiskToLevel = (risk: string) {
        case(
            risk == "critical", 100,
            risk == "high", 75,
            risk == "medium", 50,
            risk == "low", 25,
            0
        )
    };
    let DirectionToASim = (dir: string) {
        case(
            dir == "outgoing", "Outbound",
            dir == "incoming", "Inbound",
            dir == "local", "Local",
            "Unknown"
        )
    };
    let DurationToSeconds = (d: string) {
        let h = toint(extract(@'(\d+)h', 1, d));
        let m = toint(extract(@'(\d+)m', 1, d));
        let s = toint(extract(@'(\d+)s', 1, d));
        coalesce(h, 0) * 3600 + coalesce(m, 0) * 60 + coalesce(s, 0)
    };
    let SizeToBytes = (sz: string) {
        let num = todouble(extract(@'([\d\.]+)', 1, sz));
        let unit = extract(@'[\d\.]+\s*([A-Za-z]+)', 1, sz);
        case(
            unit == "GB", tolong(num * 1024 * 1024 * 1024),
            unit == "MB", tolong(num * 1024 * 1024),
            unit == "KB", tolong(num * 1024),
            unit == "B", tolong(num),
            tolong(num)
        )
    };
    Ubiquiti_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    | where Message has "CEF: 0|Ubiquiti|UniFi Network|"
    | parse Message with
        RawTimestamp: string
        " "
        SyslogHostname: string
        " CEF: "
        CefVersion: int
        "|"
        DeviceVendor: string
        "|"
        DeviceProduct: string
        "|"
        DeviceVersion: string
        "|"
        DeviceEventClassID: string
        "|"
        Name: string
        "|"
        Severity: int
        "|"
        Extension: string
    | where DeviceEventClassID in ("201", "203", "400", "401", "402", "403", "404", "520", "521", "522", "523")
    | extend
        category = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIcategory=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        host = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIhost=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        proto = extract(@'(?:^|\s)proto=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        spt = extract(@'(?:^|\s)spt=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        dpt = extract(@'(?:^|\s)dpt=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        act = extract(@'(?:^|\s)act=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        app = extract(@'(?:^|\s)app=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        src = extract(@'(?:^|\s)src=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        dst = extract(@'(?:^|\s)dst=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        risk = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIrisk=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        policyName = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIpolicyName=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        policyType = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIpolicyType=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        direction = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIdirection=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        deviceInboundInterface = extract(@'(?:^|\s)deviceInboundInterface=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        deviceOutboundInterface = extract(@'(?:^|\s)deviceOutboundInterface=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        deviceMac = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIdeviceMac=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        deviceName = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIdeviceName=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        deviceModel = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIdeviceModel=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        deviceIp = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIdeviceIp=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        deviceVersion = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIdeviceVersion=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        srcRegion = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIsrcRegion=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        dstRegion = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIdstRegion=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        srcZone = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIsrcZone=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        dstZone = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIdstZone=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        totalBytes = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFItotalBytes=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        totalPackets = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFItotalPackets=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        packetsReceived = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIpacketsReceived=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        packetsSent = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIpacketsSent=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        bytesReceived = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIbytesReceived=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        bytesSent = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIbytesSent=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        flowId = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIflowId=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        ipsSessionId = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIipsSessionId=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        ipsSignature = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIipsSignature=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        ipsSignatureId = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIipsSignatureId=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        firewallPolicy = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIfirewallPolicy=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        srcClientAlias = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIsrcClientAlias=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        srcClientHostname = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIsrcClientHostname=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        srcClientIp = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIsrcClientIp=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        srcClientMac = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIsrcClientMac=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        utcTime = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIutcTime=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        connectedToDeviceName = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIconnectedToDeviceName=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        connectedToDeviceIp = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIconnectedToDeviceIp=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        connectedToDeviceMac = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIconnectedToDeviceMac=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        connectedToDeviceModel = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIconnectedToDeviceModel=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        connectedToDevicePort = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIconnectedToDevicePort=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        lastConnectedToDeviceName = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIlastConnectedToDeviceName=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        lastConnectedToDeviceIp = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIlastConnectedToDeviceIp=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        lastConnectedToDeviceMac = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIlastConnectedToDeviceMac=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        lastConnectedToDeviceModel = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIlastConnectedToDeviceModel=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        lastConnectedToDevicePort = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIlastConnectedToDevicePort=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        clientAlias = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIclientAlias=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        clientHostname = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIclientHostname=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        clientIp = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIclientIp=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        clientMac = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIclientMac=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        wifiChannel = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIwifiChannel=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        wifiChannelWidth = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIwifiChannelWidth=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        wifiName = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIwifiName=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        wifiBand = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIwifiBand=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        wifiRssi = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIWiFiRssi=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        authMethod = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIauthMethod=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        networkName = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFInetworkName=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        networkSubnet = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFInetworkSubnet=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        networkVlan = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFInetworkVlan=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        duration = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIduration=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        usageDown = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIusageDown=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        usageUp = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIusageUp=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        linkSpeed = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIlinkSpeed=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        wanId = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIwanId=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        suser = extract(@'(?:^|\s)suser=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        vpnName = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIvpnName=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        vpnType = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIvpnType=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        vpnServerAddress = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIvpnServerAddress=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        vpnSubnet = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIvpnSubnet=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension)
    | extend
        IsConnectEvent = DeviceEventClassID in ("400", "402", "403", "522", "520"),
        IsNewSessionEvent = DeviceEventClassID in ("400", "403", "522", "520"),
        IsDisconnectEvent = DeviceEventClassID in ("401", "404", "521", "523"),
        IsThreatOrFirewallEvent = DeviceEventClassID in ("201", "203"),
        IsVpnEvent = DeviceEventClassID in ("520", "521", "522", "523"),
        IsWifiOrWiredEvent = DeviceEventClassID in ("400", "401", "402", "403", "404")
    | extend
        EventOriginalUid = flowId,
        NetworkSessionId = iff(flowId == "null" or isempty(flowId), "", flowId),
        EventEndTimeParsed = todatetime(utcTime),
        NetworkDurationSeconds = toint(iff(isnotempty(duration), DurationToSeconds(duration), int(null)))
    | extend
        EventEndTime = EventEndTimeParsed,
        EventStartTime = iff(isnotempty(NetworkDurationSeconds), EventEndTimeParsed - (1s * NetworkDurationSeconds), EventEndTimeParsed),
        SrcBytes = case(
            IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, toint(bytesSent),
            IsDisconnectEvent and IsVpnEvent == false, SizeToBytes(usageUp),
            int(null)
        ),
        DstBytes = case(
            IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, toint(bytesReceived),
            IsDisconnectEvent and IsVpnEvent == false, SizeToBytes(usageDown),
            int(null)
        ),
        NetworkBytes = case(
            IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, toint(totalBytes),
            IsDisconnectEvent and IsVpnEvent, SizeToBytes(usageUp) + SizeToBytes(usageDown),
            long(null)
        ),
        NetworkPackets = iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, toint(totalPackets), long(null)),
        SrcPackets = iff(DeviceEventClassID == "201", toint(packetsSent), long(null)),
        DstPackets = iff(DeviceEventClassID == "201", toint(packetsReceived), long(null))
    | extend
        SrcIpAddr = case(
            DeviceEventClassID == "201", src,
            DeviceEventClassID == "203", srcClientIp,
            DeviceEventClassID in ("400", "402", "403"), clientIp,
            DeviceEventClassID in ("401", "404"), clientIp,
            DeviceEventClassID == "520", src,
            DeviceEventClassID in ("522"), clientIp,
            ""
        ),
        SrcMacAddr = case(
            DeviceEventClassID == "203", srcClientMac,
            IsWifiOrWiredEvent and IsConnectEvent, clientMac,
            IsWifiOrWiredEvent and IsDisconnectEvent, clientMac,
            ""
        ),
        SrcHostname = case(
            DeviceEventClassID == "203", SanitizeHostname(srcClientHostname),
            IsWifiOrWiredEvent, SanitizeHostname(clientHostname),
            ""
        ),
        SrcNatIpAddr = iff(DeviceEventClassID in ("520", "522"), clientIp, ""),
        SrcUsername = iff(IsVpnEvent, suser, ""),
        SrcUsernameType = iff(IsVpnEvent and isnotempty(suser), "Simple", ""),
        SrcZone = iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, srcZone, ""),
        SrcGeoCountry = iff(DeviceEventClassID == "201", srcRegion, ""),
        DstIpAddr = case(
            IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, dst,
            IsVpnEvent, vpnServerAddress,
            IsConnectEvent and IsWifiOrWiredEvent, connectedToDeviceIp,
            IsDisconnectEvent and IsWifiOrWiredEvent, lastConnectedToDeviceIp,
            ""
        ),
        DstMacAddr = case(
            IsConnectEvent and IsWifiOrWiredEvent, connectedToDeviceMac,
            IsDisconnectEvent and IsWifiOrWiredEvent, lastConnectedToDeviceMac,
            ""
        ),
        DstHostname = case(
            IsConnectEvent and IsWifiOrWiredEvent, SanitizeHostname(connectedToDeviceName),
            IsDisconnectEvent and IsWifiOrWiredEvent, SanitizeHostname(lastConnectedToDeviceName),
            ""
        ),
        DstInterfaceName = case(
            IsConnectEvent and DeviceEventClassID == "403", connectedToDevicePort,
            IsDisconnectEvent and DeviceEventClassID == "404", lastConnectedToDevicePort,
            ""
        ),
        DstZone = iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, dstZone, ""),
        DstGeoCountry = iff(DeviceEventClassID == "201", dstRegion, ""),
        DstVlanId = iff(IsWifiOrWiredEvent, networkVlan, "")
    | extend
        Src = coalesce(iff(isempty(SrcHostname), "", SrcHostname), iff(isempty(SrcIpAddr), "", SrcIpAddr)),
        Dst = coalesce(iff(isempty(DstHostname), "", DstHostname), iff(isempty(DstIpAddr), "", DstIpAddr)),
        NetworkProtocol = iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent and isnotempty(proto), toupper(proto), ""),
        NetworkApplicationProtocol = iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent and isnotempty(app) and app != "Other", app, ""),
        SrcPortNumber = iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, toint(spt), int(null)),
        DstPortNumber = iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, toint(dpt), int(null)),
        NetworkDirection = iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, DirectionToASim(direction), ""),
        DvcInboundInterface = iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, deviceInboundInterface, ""),
        DvcOutboundInterface = iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, deviceOutboundInterface, ""),
        DvcAction = case(
            act == "blocked", "Deny",
            IsNewSessionEvent, "Allow",
            ""
        ),
        NetworkRuleName = case(
            DeviceEventClassID == "201", policyName,
            DeviceEventClassID == "203", coalesce(iff(isempty(firewallPolicy), "", firewallPolicy), policyName),
            IsVpnEvent, vpnName,
            ""
        ),
        ThreatCategory = iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, policyType, ""),
        ThreatOriginalRiskLevel = iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, risk, ""),
        ThreatRiskLevel = toint(iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent and isnotempty(risk), RiskToLevel(risk), int(null))),
        ThreatName = iff(DeviceEventClassID == "201", ipsSignature, ""),
        ThreatId = iff(DeviceEventClassID == "201", ipsSignatureId, "")
    | extend
        Dvc = host,
        DvcHostname = SanitizeHostname(host),
        DvcIpAddr = iff(DeviceEventClassID == "201", deviceIp, ""),
        ASimMatchingIpAddr = "Both",
        ASimMatchingHostname = case(
            isnotempty(SrcHostname) and isnotempty(DstHostname), "Both",
            isnotempty(SrcHostname), "SrcHostname",
            isnotempty(DstHostname), "DstHostname",
            "-"
        ),
        EventOriginalType = Name,
        EventOriginalSubType = category,
        EventSubType = case(
            IsNewSessionEvent, "Start",
            IsDisconnectEvent, "End",
            ""
        ),
        EventProductVersion = DeviceVersion,
        EventSeverity = SeverityToASim(Severity),
        EventOriginalSeverity = tostring(Severity),
        EventType = "NetworkSession",
        EventResult = "Success",
        EventCount = int(1),
        EventVendor = "Ubiquiti",
        EventProduct = "UniFi Network",
        EventSchema = "NetworkSession",
        EventSchemaVersion = "0.2.7",
        Type = "Ubiquiti_CL"
    | extend
        AdditionalFields = iff(
            pack,
            bag_pack(
                "DeviceMac", deviceMac,
                "DeviceName", deviceName,
                "DeviceModel", deviceModel,
                "DeviceIp", deviceIp,
                "SrcClientAlias", srcClientAlias,
                "ConnectedToDeviceModel", connectedToDeviceModel,
                "LastConnectedToDeviceModel", lastConnectedToDeviceModel,
                "ClientAlias", clientAlias,
                "WifiChannel", wifiChannel,
                "WifiChannelWidth", wifiChannelWidth,
                "WifiName", wifiName,
                "WifiBand", wifiBand,
                "WifiRssi", wifiRssi,
                "AuthMethod", authMethod,
                "NetworkName", networkName,
                "NetworkSubnet", networkSubnet,
                "LinkSpeed", linkSpeed,
                "WanId", wanId,
                "VpnType", vpnType,
                "VpnSubnet", vpnSubnet,
                "IpsSessionId", ipsSessionId
            ),
            dynamic(null)
        )
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        EventStartTime,
        EventEndTime,
        EventType,
        EventSubType,
        EventResult,
        EventSeverity,
        EventOriginalSeverity,
        EventCount,
        EventVendor,
        EventProduct,
        EventProductVersion,
        EventSchema,
        EventSchemaVersion,
        EventOriginalType,
        EventOriginalSubType,
        EventOriginalUid,
        Dvc,
        DvcHostname,
        DvcIpAddr,
        ASimMatchingIpAddr,
        ASimMatchingHostname,
        DvcAction,
        DvcInboundInterface,
        DvcOutboundInterface,
        Src,
        SrcIpAddr,
        SrcPortNumber,
        SrcHostname,
        SrcMacAddr,
        SrcNatIpAddr,
        SrcZone,
        SrcGeoCountry,
        SrcBytes,
        SrcPackets,
        SrcUsername,
        SrcUsernameType,
        Dst,
        DstIpAddr,
        DstPortNumber,
        DstHostname,
        DstMacAddr,
        DstInterfaceName,
        DstZone,
        DstGeoCountry,
        DstVlanId,
        DstBytes,
        DstPackets,
        NetworkProtocol,
        NetworkApplicationProtocol,
        NetworkDirection,
        NetworkBytes,
        NetworkPackets,
        NetworkDuration = NetworkDurationSeconds,
        NetworkRuleName,
        NetworkSessionId,
        ThreatCategory,
        ThreatOriginalRiskLevel,
        ThreatRiskLevel,
        ThreatName,
        ThreatId,
        AdditionalFields,
        SrcUserEntityKey = "",
        DstUserEntityKey = "",
        SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
        DstSystemEntityKey = "",
        DvcEntityKey = "",
        SrcApplicationEntityKey = "",
        DstApplicationEntityKey = "",
        SrcUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
        DstUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
        AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
        Type,
        Duration = NetworkDurationSeconds,
        OuterVlanId = DstVlanId,
        SessionId = NetworkSessionId,
        Hostname = DstHostname,
        IpAddr = SrcIpAddr
};
ASimNetworkSessionUbiquitiUniFiNetwork(disabled=False)

let vimNetworkSessionUbiquitiUniFiNetwork = (
    starttime: datetime = datetime(null),
    endtime: datetime = datetime(null),
    srcipaddr_has_any_prefix: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    dstipaddr_has_any_prefix: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    ipaddr_has_any_prefix: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    dstportnumber: int = int(null),
    hostname_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    dvcaction: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    eventresult: string = "*",
    disabled: bool = false,
    pack: bool = false
) {
    // ASIM NetworkSession parameterized parser for Ubiquiti UniFi Network (UDM Pro) CEF syslog
    // Source table: Ubiquiti_CL (raw CEF syslog line stored in Message)
    // Covers UniFi Network event classes: 201 (Threat Detected and Blocked), 203 (Blocked by Firewall),
    // 400/401/402 (WiFi Client Connected/Disconnected/Roamed), 403/404 (Wired Client Connected/Disconnected),
    // 520/521 (VPN Client Connected/Disconnected), 522/523 (Teleport Client Connected/Disconnected)
    let SanitizeHostname = (h: string) {
        trim(@'-+$', trim(@'^-+', replace_regex(h, @'[^A-Za-z0-9\-]+', '-')))
    };
    let SeverityToASim = (sev: int) {
        case(
            sev <= 3, "Informational",
            sev <= 6, "Low",
            sev <= 8, "Medium",
            "High"
        )
    };
    let RiskToLevel = (risk: string) {
        case(
            risk == "critical", 100,
            risk == "high", 75,
            risk == "medium", 50,
            risk == "low", 25,
            0
        )
    };
    let DirectionToASim = (dir: string) {
        case(
            dir == "outgoing", "Outbound",
            dir == "incoming", "Inbound",
            dir == "local", "Local",
            "Unknown"
        )
    };
    let DurationToSeconds = (d: string) {
        let h = toint(extract(@'(\d+)h', 1, d));
        let m = toint(extract(@'(\d+)m', 1, d));
        let s = toint(extract(@'(\d+)s', 1, d));
        coalesce(h, 0) * 3600 + coalesce(m, 0) * 60 + coalesce(s, 0)
    };
    let SizeToBytes = (sz: string) {
        let num = todouble(extract(@'([\d\.]+)', 1, sz));
        let unit = extract(@'[\d\.]+\s*([A-Za-z]+)', 1, sz);
        case(
            unit == "GB", tolong(num * 1024 * 1024 * 1024),
            unit == "MB", tolong(num * 1024 * 1024),
            unit == "KB", tolong(num * 1024),
            unit == "B", tolong(num),
            tolong(num)
        )
    };
    Ubiquiti_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    | where (isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime)
    | where (isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime)
    | where Message has "CEF: 0|Ubiquiti|UniFi Network|"
    | parse Message with
        RawTimestamp: string
        " "
        SyslogHostname: string
        " CEF: "
        CefVersion: int
        "|"
        DeviceVendor: string
        "|"
        DeviceProduct: string
        "|"
        DeviceVersion: string
        "|"
        DeviceEventClassID: string
        "|"
        Name: string
        "|"
        Severity: int
        "|"
        Extension: string
    | where DeviceEventClassID in ("201", "203", "400", "401", "402", "403", "404", "520", "521", "522", "523")
    | extend
        category = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIcategory=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        host = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIhost=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        proto = extract(@'(?:^|\s)proto=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        spt = extract(@'(?:^|\s)spt=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        dpt = extract(@'(?:^|\s)dpt=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        act = extract(@'(?:^|\s)act=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        app = extract(@'(?:^|\s)app=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        src = extract(@'(?:^|\s)src=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        dst = extract(@'(?:^|\s)dst=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        risk = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIrisk=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        policyName = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIpolicyName=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        policyType = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIpolicyType=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        direction = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIdirection=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        deviceInboundInterface = extract(@'(?:^|\s)deviceInboundInterface=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        deviceOutboundInterface = extract(@'(?:^|\s)deviceOutboundInterface=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        deviceMac = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIdeviceMac=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        deviceName = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIdeviceName=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        deviceModel = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIdeviceModel=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        deviceIp = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIdeviceIp=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        deviceVersion = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIdeviceVersion=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        srcRegion = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIsrcRegion=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        dstRegion = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIdstRegion=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        srcZone = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIsrcZone=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        dstZone = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIdstZone=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        totalBytes = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFItotalBytes=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        totalPackets = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFItotalPackets=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        packetsReceived = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIpacketsReceived=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        packetsSent = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIpacketsSent=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        bytesReceived = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIbytesReceived=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        bytesSent = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIbytesSent=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        flowId = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIflowId=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        ipsSessionId = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIipsSessionId=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        ipsSignature = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIipsSignature=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        ipsSignatureId = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIipsSignatureId=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        firewallPolicy = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIfirewallPolicy=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        srcClientAlias = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIsrcClientAlias=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        srcClientHostname = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIsrcClientHostname=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        srcClientIp = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIsrcClientIp=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        srcClientMac = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIsrcClientMac=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        utcTime = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIutcTime=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        connectedToDeviceName = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIconnectedToDeviceName=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        connectedToDeviceIp = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIconnectedToDeviceIp=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        connectedToDeviceMac = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIconnectedToDeviceMac=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        connectedToDeviceModel = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIconnectedToDeviceModel=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        connectedToDevicePort = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIconnectedToDevicePort=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        lastConnectedToDeviceName = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIlastConnectedToDeviceName=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        lastConnectedToDeviceIp = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIlastConnectedToDeviceIp=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        lastConnectedToDeviceMac = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIlastConnectedToDeviceMac=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        lastConnectedToDeviceModel = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIlastConnectedToDeviceModel=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        lastConnectedToDevicePort = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIlastConnectedToDevicePort=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        clientAlias = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIclientAlias=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        clientHostname = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIclientHostname=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        clientIp = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIclientIp=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        clientMac = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIclientMac=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        wifiChannel = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIwifiChannel=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        wifiChannelWidth = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIwifiChannelWidth=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        wifiName = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIwifiName=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        wifiBand = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIwifiBand=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        wifiRssi = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIWiFiRssi=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        authMethod = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIauthMethod=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        networkName = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFInetworkName=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        networkSubnet = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFInetworkSubnet=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        networkVlan = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFInetworkVlan=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        duration = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIduration=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        usageDown = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIusageDown=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        usageUp = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIusageUp=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        linkSpeed = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIlinkSpeed=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        wanId = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIwanId=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        suser = extract(@'(?:^|\s)suser=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        vpnName = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIvpnName=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        vpnType = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIvpnType=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        vpnServerAddress = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIvpnServerAddress=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension),
        vpnSubnet = extract(@'(?:^|\s)UNIFIvpnSubnet=(.*?)(?:\s[A-Za-z]+=|$)', 1, Extension)
    | extend
        IsConnectEvent = DeviceEventClassID in ("400", "402", "403", "522", "520"),
        IsNewSessionEvent = DeviceEventClassID in ("400", "403", "522", "520"),
        IsDisconnectEvent = DeviceEventClassID in ("401", "404", "521", "523"),
        IsThreatOrFirewallEvent = DeviceEventClassID in ("201", "203"),
        IsVpnEvent = DeviceEventClassID in ("520", "521", "522", "523"),
        IsWifiOrWiredEvent = DeviceEventClassID in ("400", "401", "402", "403", "404")
    | extend
        EventOriginalUid = flowId,
        NetworkSessionId = iff(flowId == "null" or isempty(flowId), "", flowId),
        EventEndTimeParsed = todatetime(utcTime),
        NetworkDurationSeconds = toint(iff(isnotempty(duration), DurationToSeconds(duration), int(null)))
    | extend
        EventEndTime = EventEndTimeParsed,
        EventStartTime = iff(isnotempty(NetworkDurationSeconds), EventEndTimeParsed - (1s * NetworkDurationSeconds), EventEndTimeParsed),
        SrcBytes = case(
            IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, toint(bytesSent),
            IsDisconnectEvent and IsVpnEvent == false, SizeToBytes(usageUp),
            int(null)
        ),
        DstBytes = case(
            IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, toint(bytesReceived),
            IsDisconnectEvent and IsVpnEvent == false, SizeToBytes(usageDown),
            int(null)
        ),
        NetworkBytes = case(
            IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, toint(totalBytes),
            IsDisconnectEvent and IsVpnEvent, SizeToBytes(usageUp) + SizeToBytes(usageDown),
            long(null)
        ),
        NetworkPackets = iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, toint(totalPackets), long(null)),
        SrcPackets = iff(DeviceEventClassID == "201", toint(packetsSent), long(null)),
        DstPackets = iff(DeviceEventClassID == "201", toint(packetsReceived), long(null))
    | extend
        SrcIpAddr = case(
            DeviceEventClassID == "201", src,
            DeviceEventClassID == "203", srcClientIp,
            DeviceEventClassID in ("400", "402", "403"), clientIp,
            DeviceEventClassID in ("401", "404"), clientIp,
            DeviceEventClassID == "520", src,
            DeviceEventClassID in ("522"), clientIp,
            ""
        ),
        SrcMacAddr = case(
            DeviceEventClassID == "203", srcClientMac,
            IsWifiOrWiredEvent and IsConnectEvent, clientMac,
            IsWifiOrWiredEvent and IsDisconnectEvent, clientMac,
            ""
        ),
        SrcHostname = case(
            DeviceEventClassID == "203", SanitizeHostname(srcClientHostname),
            IsWifiOrWiredEvent, SanitizeHostname(clientHostname),
            ""
        ),
        SrcNatIpAddr = iff(DeviceEventClassID in ("520", "522"), clientIp, ""),
        SrcUsername = iff(IsVpnEvent, suser, ""),
        SrcUsernameType = iff(IsVpnEvent and isnotempty(suser), "Simple", ""),
        SrcZone = iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, srcZone, ""),
        SrcGeoCountry = iff(DeviceEventClassID == "201", srcRegion, ""),
        DstIpAddr = case(
            IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, dst,
            IsVpnEvent, vpnServerAddress,
            IsConnectEvent and IsWifiOrWiredEvent, connectedToDeviceIp,
            IsDisconnectEvent and IsWifiOrWiredEvent, lastConnectedToDeviceIp,
            ""
        ),
        DstMacAddr = case(
            IsConnectEvent and IsWifiOrWiredEvent, connectedToDeviceMac,
            IsDisconnectEvent and IsWifiOrWiredEvent, lastConnectedToDeviceMac,
            ""
        ),
        DstHostname = case(
            IsConnectEvent and IsWifiOrWiredEvent, SanitizeHostname(connectedToDeviceName),
            IsDisconnectEvent and IsWifiOrWiredEvent, SanitizeHostname(lastConnectedToDeviceName),
            ""
        ),
        DstInterfaceName = case(
            IsConnectEvent and DeviceEventClassID == "403", connectedToDevicePort,
            IsDisconnectEvent and DeviceEventClassID == "404", lastConnectedToDevicePort,
            ""
        ),
        DstZone = iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, dstZone, ""),
        DstGeoCountry = iff(DeviceEventClassID == "201", dstRegion, ""),
        DstVlanId = iff(IsWifiOrWiredEvent, networkVlan, "")
    | extend
        Src = coalesce(iff(isempty(SrcHostname), "", SrcHostname), iff(isempty(SrcIpAddr), "", SrcIpAddr)),
        Dst = coalesce(iff(isempty(DstHostname), "", DstHostname), iff(isempty(DstIpAddr), "", DstIpAddr)),
        NetworkProtocol = iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent and isnotempty(proto), toupper(proto), ""),
        NetworkApplicationProtocol = iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent and isnotempty(app) and app != "Other", app, ""),
        SrcPortNumber = iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, toint(spt), int(null)),
        DstPortNumber = iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, toint(dpt), int(null)),
        NetworkDirection = iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, DirectionToASim(direction), ""),
        DvcInboundInterface = iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, deviceInboundInterface, ""),
        DvcOutboundInterface = iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, deviceOutboundInterface, ""),
        DvcAction = case(
            act == "blocked", "Deny",
            IsNewSessionEvent, "Allow",
            ""
        ),
        NetworkRuleName = case(
            DeviceEventClassID == "201", policyName,
            DeviceEventClassID == "203", coalesce(iff(isempty(firewallPolicy), "", firewallPolicy), policyName),
            IsVpnEvent, vpnName,
            ""
        ),
        ThreatCategory = iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, policyType, ""),
        ThreatOriginalRiskLevel = iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent, risk, ""),
        ThreatRiskLevel = toint(iff(IsThreatOrFirewallEvent and isnotempty(risk), RiskToLevel(risk), int(null))),
        ThreatName = iff(DeviceEventClassID == "201", ipsSignature, ""),
        ThreatId = iff(DeviceEventClassID == "201", ipsSignatureId, "")
    | extend
        Dvc = host,
        DvcHostname = SanitizeHostname(host),
        DvcIpAddr = iff(DeviceEventClassID == "201", deviceIp, ""),
        ASimMatchingIpAddr = "Both",
        ASimMatchingHostname = case(
            isnotempty(SrcHostname) and isnotempty(DstHostname), "Both",
            isnotempty(SrcHostname), "SrcHostname",
            isnotempty(DstHostname), "DstHostname",
            "-"
        ),
        EventOriginalType = Name,
        EventOriginalSubType = category,
        EventSubType = case(
            IsNewSessionEvent, "Start",
            IsDisconnectEvent, "End",
            ""
        ),
        EventProductVersion = DeviceVersion,
        EventSeverity = SeverityToASim(Severity),
        EventOriginalSeverity = tostring(Severity),
        EventType = "NetworkSession",
        EventResult = "Success",
        EventCount = int(1),
        EventVendor = "Ubiquiti",
        EventProduct = "UniFi Network",
        EventSchema = "NetworkSession",
        EventSchemaVersion = "0.2.7",
        Type = "Ubiquiti_CL"
    | extend
        AdditionalFields = iff(
            pack,
            bag_pack(
                "DeviceMac", deviceMac,
                "DeviceName", deviceName,
                "DeviceModel", deviceModel,
                "DeviceIp", deviceIp,
                "SrcClientAlias", srcClientAlias,
                "ConnectedToDeviceModel", connectedToDeviceModel,
                "LastConnectedToDeviceModel", lastConnectedToDeviceModel,
                "ClientAlias", clientAlias,
                "WifiChannel", wifiChannel,
                "WifiChannelWidth", wifiChannelWidth,
                "WifiName", wifiName,
                "WifiBand", wifiBand,
                "WifiRssi", wifiRssi,
                "AuthMethod", authMethod,
                "NetworkName", networkName,
                "NetworkSubnet", networkSubnet,
                "LinkSpeed", linkSpeed,
                "WanId", wanId,
                "VpnType", vpnType,
                "VpnSubnet", vpnSubnet,
                "IpsSessionId", ipsSessionId
            ),
            dynamic(null)
        )
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        EventStartTime,
        EventEndTime,
        EventType,
        EventSubType,
        EventResult,
        EventSeverity,
        EventOriginalSeverity,
        EventCount,
        EventVendor,
        EventProduct,
        EventProductVersion,
        EventSchema,
        EventSchemaVersion,
        EventOriginalType,
        EventOriginalSubType,
        EventOriginalUid,
        Dvc,
        DvcHostname,
        DvcIpAddr,
        ASimMatchingIpAddr,
        ASimMatchingHostname,
        DvcAction,
        DvcInboundInterface,
        DvcOutboundInterface,
        Src,
        SrcIpAddr,
        SrcPortNumber,
        SrcHostname,
        SrcMacAddr,
        SrcNatIpAddr,
        SrcZone,
        SrcGeoCountry,
        SrcBytes,
        SrcPackets,
        SrcUsername,
        SrcUsernameType,
        Dst,
        DstIpAddr,
        DstPortNumber,
        DstHostname,
        DstMacAddr,
        DstInterfaceName,
        DstZone,
        DstGeoCountry,
        DstVlanId,
        DstBytes,
        DstPackets,
        NetworkProtocol,
        NetworkApplicationProtocol,
        NetworkDirection,
        NetworkBytes,
        NetworkPackets,
        NetworkDuration = NetworkDurationSeconds,
        NetworkRuleName,
        NetworkSessionId,
        ThreatCategory,
        ThreatOriginalRiskLevel,
        ThreatRiskLevel,
        ThreatName,
        ThreatId,
        AdditionalFields,
        SrcUserEntityKey = "",
        DstUserEntityKey = "",
        SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
        DstSystemEntityKey = "",
        DvcEntityKey = "",
        SrcApplicationEntityKey = "",
        DstApplicationEntityKey = "",
        SrcUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
        DstUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
        AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
        Type,
        Duration = NetworkDurationSeconds,
        OuterVlanId = DstVlanId,
        SessionId = NetworkSessionId,
        Hostname = DstHostname,
        IpAddr = SrcIpAddr
    | where array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 or has_any_ipv4_prefix(SrcIpAddr, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix)
    | where array_length(dstipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 or has_any_ipv4_prefix(DstIpAddr, dstipaddr_has_any_prefix)
    | where array_length(ipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 or has_any_ipv4_prefix(SrcIpAddr, ipaddr_has_any_prefix) or has_any_ipv4_prefix(DstIpAddr, ipaddr_has_any_prefix)
    | where isnull(dstportnumber) or DstPortNumber == dstportnumber
    | where array_length(hostname_has_any) == 0 or SrcHostname has_any (hostname_has_any) or DstHostname has_any (hostname_has_any)
    | where array_length(dvcaction) == 0 or DvcAction in (dvcaction)
    | where eventresult == "*" or EventResult == eventresult
};
